sections.heading: Flying While Pregnant
sections.body: Important information to help you prepare for your journey. Please read the below information to ensure we can help make your journey as comfortable and safe as possible.

sections.heading: Travel Eligibility
sections.body:
The certificate or letter must be available on request and be carried with you at the airport and during the flight in your cabin baggage.

Medical clearance is required if the pregnancy is not routine and you are experiencing any complications with your pregnancy.

Please call our reservations team on +61 7 3229 6455 for further details

**Single Pregnancy**: up to the end of week 36

**Multiple Pregnancy (e.g. twins)**: up to the end of week 32

Medical clearance is required if you are travelling within 7 days after your delivery date. Infants cannot travel for 48 hours after delivery and need Medical clearance to travel between 3 and 7 days after delivery.

Some countries place limitations on the entry of non-national pregnant women. It is best to check with the local consulate to confirm their country specific requirements.

sections.heading: After 28 Weeks
sections.body:
After 28 weeks, you need to carry a certificate or letter from a registered medical practitioner or registered midwife confirming:
- The estimated date of delivery
- Whether it is a single or multiple pregnancy
- That the pregnancy is a routine pregnancy and that there are no complications
sections.note: **Important**: The Certificate Or Letter Must Be Available On Request And Carried With You At The Airport And During The Flight In Your Cabin Baggage.

sections.heading: Medical Clearance
sections.body:
Medical clearance is required if:
- The pregnancy is not routine
- You are experiencing complications with your pregnancy
- You are travelling within 7 days after your delivery date

Reservations - +61 7 3229 6455

sections.heading: Travelling After Delivery
sections.body:
- Infants cannot travel for 48 hours after delivery
- Medical clearance is required to travel between 3 and 7 days after delivery

sections.heading: Important Medical Advice
sections.body: You must seek advice from your own medical practitioner prior to your flight. The periods referred to above are only our minimum requirements.
